summary: Iter 95 — Frontend-only end-to-end validation of the 5 new Defensibility enhancements against the LIVE owner org (jblan2026@gmail.com): (1) Governance settings (Digest day/recipients/enabled + SLA hours) save + persist across reload; (2) Runtime playbooks — signed webhook contract with Copy + 4 provider cards (generic/langgraph/crewai/bedrock) expand with adapter Copy + docs link; (3) Two-way workspace — public question → admin threaded reply with Attach signed evidence PDF (status flips to Answered) → public thread shows GOVERNANCE reply + PDF paperclip note WITHOUT the admin email → auditor follow-up appended and status returns to Open → admin Resolve exposes Reopen button; (4) Watermark — public download href includes ?who=<name>; (5) Board digest — POST /board-evidence-digest/send returns 200 {sent:1}. Auditor Room create/revoke also revalidated. ALL 15 measured checks passed. Baseline restored (all auditor rooms revoked, governance reset to day=1, sla=48, recipients=[]).

design_issues.screen: Public /audit-room thread heading for admin messages
issues: Spec wording says the admin identity is shown as 'Governance team'; the portal actually renders the heading as 'GOVERNANCE REPLY' (all-caps) with no email — semantically equivalent (no email leak) but the exact 'Governance team' phrasing referenced in the spec is not shown verbatim. Non-blocking.

design_issues.screen: Auditor questions inbox thread label (admin side)
issues: Same 'GOVERNANCE' vs 'Governance team' phrasing inconsistency in the admin card header — cosmetic only.

action_items: (Optional / cosmetic) If the spec requires the literal phrase 'Governance team' on the public thread, update the AuditRoom Thread component heading from 'GOVERNANCE REPLY' to include 'Governance team'. Backend already stores by='Governance team' — only the UI label differs.
critical_code_review_comments: AuditRoom.jsx submitQuestion posts { author, email, text } while backend RoomCommentBody accepts (body.author/body.email/body.text). Consistent. Public POST /public/evidence-room/{token}/comment correctly returned 200 in-browser.

GET /api/agents/runtime/evidence-room-comments returns {comments:[…], sla_hours:<int>} — SLA is at the ROOT of the response, not per-item. Per-item field is `overdue: bool`. Frontend correctly reads both.

board-evidence-digest/send is synchronous SMTP and can take >8s to respond; UI toast is fine but Playwright/response listeners need a >15s timeout. Consider making it fire-and-forget or add optimistic UI.
AuditorQuestionsCard header does not surface the SLA-hours numeric anywhere — only 'N open' badge (and 'N overdue' if any). Consider showing 'SLA 24h' next to counts for context.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified this run: (a) Governance settings: PUT /api/agents/runtime/governance-settings clamps day 1-28, sla 1-720 and stores recipients array. UI testids gov-digest-day / gov-digest-recipients / gov-sla-hours / gov-digest-enabled / gov-save. Values PERSIST across page reload + tab-switch (localStorage key agentic-ai-security-tab keeps you on Defensibility). (b) Runtime playbooks: 4 provider cards render generic/langgraph/crewai/bedrock, top-level signed webhook contract JSON has playbook-copy-payload, each expanded provider has playbook-copy-<id> + 1 'Provider docs' <a> link. (c) Public POST /api/agents/public/evidence-room/{token}/comment field name is TEXT (not message/body). Playwright must .fill() name/email/text and use native locator.click() after networkidle — using force=True + input events sometimes drops the React state and the button click becomes a no-op with no POST fired. Wait for [data-testid=audit-room-question-sent]. (d) Admin GET /api/agents/runtime/evidence-room-comments → {comments:[{id, token, status, messages:[…], overdue:bool, ...}], sla_hours:int}. sla_hours is ROOT-level. (e) Reply flow: click auditor-question-reply-btn-<id> → fill auditor-question-reply-input-<id> → check auditor-question-attach-<id> → click auditor-question-reply-send-<id>. Status flips to 'Answered' and card shows 'AI ENFORCEMENT EVIDENCE PACK (PDF)' inline. (f) Public portal thread ([data-testid=audit-room-thread]) after reply shows 'GOVERNANCE REPLY' heading (NOT 'Governance team' verbatim) + 'AI ENFORCEMENT EVIDENCE PACK (PDF)' inline note; author_email 'jblan2026@gmail.com' is NOT leaked (verified). (g) Public follow-up: click audit-room-followup-btn-<id> → fill audit-room-followup-input-<id> → click audit-room-followup-send-<id>. POST /comment/{cid}/message returns 200, status returns to Open, new auditor message appended. (h) Admin Resolve (auditor-question-resolve-<id>) → Reopen button (auditor-question-reopen-<id>) appears. (i) Watermark: audit-room-download href = /api/agents/public/evidence-room/<token>/pack.pdf?who=<encoded name>. Typing in audit-room-dl-name updates ?who= live. (j) Board digest button response can take >8s (SMTP). Direct API returned 200 {sent:1}. (k) Revoke: row disappears from list; public URL then returns audit-room-error. Onboarding tour ([data-testid=tour-skip]) still overlays first-visit — must dismiss before clicking agentic-tab-defensibility. Nothing else touched; AGT-001 status untouched.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all 5 requested Defensibility enhancements work end-to-end on the frontend. The only nit is a cosmetic phrasing mismatch: the public thread heading renders as 'GOVERNANCE REPLY' rather than 'Governance team' as the spec description states — no admin email is leaked, so the security intent is preserved. Backend already tags admin messages internally with by='Governance team'; only the AuditRoom Thread label ('GOVERNANCE REPLY') would need to be updated to satisfy the literal spec wording.
